title: The Night of Open Doors
text: For one night no lock in the city will hold. Bolts slide back by themselves and doors swing wide on the wind, and something walks the streets, trying every handle. Every House must choose: guard its halls, or hide its stores.

outcomes.text: Shapes test the doors, one by one, and move on.
The guards meet something in the cellars, and come back changed.

options.label: Hide the stores and bar the inner rooms.

outcomes.text: The stores are safe. In the morning there are muddy prints outside every inner door.
Someone, or something, found the stores anyway.
